title: EDGE-A1620 Small-Area Backcheck Transition Game
source_text: Backcheck Game. Players start by attacking 2v0 with 2 opposing players backchecking them. When the backcheckers gain possession of the puck, they breakout two players on their team waiting to attack the other way. After the offensive players are stopped, they become the backcheckers. Shift goes offense, backcheck to defense, breakout your team and change.
game_problem: Attack quickly while being tracked from behind, then transition immediately from offense to backcheck/defense and breakout support after possession changes.
representative_information: Puck possession, two attackers, two backcheckers, net, turnover or defensive stop, waiting teammates for breakout.
player_decisions: Attackers choose how to create a scoring chance before pressure arrives; backcheckers track, pressure and recover possession; after the stop, players recognize the role change and support the breakout.
space_organization: Small-area two-direction game using two nearby nets; starts 2v0 with two opposing backcheckers and transitions continuously after possession changes.
coach_notes: The value is the role transition, not a prescribed route. Let puck possession determine when players change from attack to backcheck/defense.
adaptation_text: Keep shifts short and change groups after the breakout/attack sequence is completed. Restart quickly if the puck leaves the area so the offense-to-backcheck transition repeats.
source_boundary: Player numbers, 2v0 attack, two backcheckers, possession-triggered breakout, role change and shift sequence are source-derived. Shift-length/restart guidance is Carolina EDGE adaptation.

title: EDGE-A1110 Nets Back-to-Back One-Goalie Transition Game
source_text: DT500 Nets Back to Back - One Goalie U15. Quick transition and all 4 game playing roles are practiced. Goalie awareness and fitness. Put the nets back to back and one goalie defends both nets. Make two teams, half play and half are active jokers. This is a transition game so you must pass to your joker to be on offense. On transition the goalie switches nets. Allow Jokers to check Jokers. Keep score. Jokers should surround the play. Jokers can either pass or shoot. Having active Jokers keep everyone involved.
game_problem: Transition quickly through an outside joker while one goalie reads the possession change and switches between back-to-back nets.
representative_information: Possession change, joker support, puck location, which net is now being attacked, goalie orientation, teammate/opponent spacing.
player_decisions: Players decide which joker to use and how to attack after transition; jokers decide pass or shot; goalie reads possession and switches nets.
space_organization: Small-area game around two back-to-back nets with one goalie defending both and active jokers surrounding the play.
goalie: YES - ONE GOALIE DEFENDS BOTH NETS
coach_notes: Preserve the mandatory joker touch before becoming offense; that is the transition trigger for both skaters and goalie.
adaptation_text: Use short competitive shifts and rotate the goalie if workload becomes excessive. Keep the joker ring active so waiting players remain involved.
source_boundary: Back-to-back nets, one goalie, active jokers, mandatory joker pass, goalie switch, joker options and scoring are source-derived. Shift/workload guidance is Carolina EDGE adaptation.

title: EDGE-A1129 Goalie vs Shooters Rebound Game
source_text: E1 Rebound Game. This is a scoring contest that seems to be loved by players of all ages everywhere in the hockey world. Make quick shots and one timers and goalie read the play. Players line up on both sides in the slot with one shooter at the top. Play games to 5 between the goalie and shooter. If the goalie freezes the puck or it hits the boards behind or at the side the goalie gets a point. Players get a point by scoring a goal on a shot or rebound. Only one pass is allowed. Shooter stays if he scores and players rotate if there is no goal.
game_problem: Goalie reads quick shot/rebound sequences while shooters compete to finish with limited passing.
representative_information: Shooter position, one-pass limit, shot release, rebound direction, freeze/board outcome and score.
player_decisions: Goalie reads and controls the first shot/rebound; shooters decide whether to shoot, use the one allowed pass, or finish a rebound.
space_organization: Slot-area scoring game with players on both sides and one shooter at the top; one goalie in net.
coach_notes: Keep the score-to-5 competition and one-pass limit; both create urgency and repeated goalie reads without prescribing the finish.
adaptation_text: Use short games and reset immediately after each point. Rotate shooters as the source directs and rotate goalies between games if multiple goalies are available.
source_boundary: Scoring system, one-pass rule, player positions, shooter-stays rotation and goalie teaching purpose are source-derived. Goalie rotation between games is Carolina EDGE adaptation.
